title: Data Compression System
short_description: Learn how data-compression systems reduce storage requirements and efficiently process encoded information using Huffman coding, binary trees, tree traversal, and priority-based processing.

real_world_context.problem: A software system needs to reduce the amount of space required to store or transmit text while preserving the original information. The system also needs to organize encoded data using tree structures and efficiently manage compression-related processing tasks.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient compression reduces storage requirements and transmission costs, while appropriate tree and priority-based algorithms help compression systems process and organize data effectively.

learning_objectives: Understand how symbol frequencies can be used to construct Huffman codes.
Apply Huffman Coding to calculate minimum compression cost.
Understand the structure and properties of binary trees.
Calculate the height of a binary tree.
Apply Breadth First Search to process a compression tree level by level.
Apply Depth First Search to explore branches of a compression tree.
Understand how priority-based greedy processing can organize compression tasks.
Choose appropriate data structures and algorithms for different compression-system requirements.

real_world_mapping.compressed_data: Reduced representation of the original information
real_world_mapping.symbol: Individual character or data item being encoded
real_world_mapping.symbol_frequency: Number of times a symbol occurs in the input data
real_world_mapping.huffman_code: Variable-length binary code assigned to each symbol
real_world_mapping.binary_tree: Hierarchical structure used to represent encoded information
real_world_mapping.compression_tree: Binary tree representing the organization of compressed data
real_world_mapping.tree_level: Depth level of a node within the compression tree
real_world_mapping.compression_task: A file or data-processing operation waiting to be processed
real_world_mapping.task_priority: Importance level used to determine compression task processing order

completion_message: You have completed the Data Compression System mission. You have learned how Huffman Coding, binary trees, BFS, DFS, and priority-based greedy processing can be applied to storage optimization, encoded data organization, and efficient compression task management.
